{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Got a folder of old pictures, made with an older model? This reads the prompt saved inside each one and makes it again with Flux 2 Klein, in the same shape, in one Run. A quick way to see how much a new model improves your old work.

 Pick your folder

  1. On Load Images from Folder Pixaroma, click Browse and pick your folder, or paste the folder's path into the box.
  2. Click Pick images, then Select all, or click only the pictures you want. The button shows how many are picked.
  3. Press Run once. Leave the Run count at 1: the node sends every picture through by itself, one after the other.

This workflow opens with no folder picked: choose your own folder, or try it first on the demo folder Old Pictures inside the Media Inputs folder that comes with these workflows.

 A folder inside ComfyUI's own input or output folder works straight away. A folder anywhere else works too, but pick it once with Browse: that is how ComfyUI knows you allowed it.

 Pictures go through in name order. Name them 01_, 02_ and so on if the order matters.

 Which pictures work

  • Pictures made with ComfyUI: every PNG it saves keeps the prompt AND the whole workflow inside. These work best.
  • Pictures from Automatic1111, Forge or downloaded from Civitai: they keep the prompt too, also as JPG or WebP.
  • Pictures from Gemini, ChatGPT, a phone or most websites keep NO prompt, and a picture edited or converted in another app usually loses it. Those give a short note instead of a prompt.
  • The demo Old Pictures were made in Gemini and saved as small JPGs, with their prompt written into each file for this demo.

 Change every prompt at once

  • Type words into the second box of Text Join Two Pixaroma, for example in winter, snow everywhere or as a watercolor painting. They are added to the end of every old prompt.
  • Leave it empty to make the old prompts exactly as they were.

 Good to know

  • Only the PROMPT is reused. The new picture is new: other model, other seed, so it will not be a copy of the old one.
  • The Seed is Fixed, so a second Run gives the same pictures. Click R for new ones.
  • A picture with no prompt inside gives Klein a short note as its prompt, so skip pictures that keep no prompt (see Which pictures work).

 A folder outside ComfyUI's own folders must be picked once with Browse on Load Images from Folder. Prompt Reader then reads from it too.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Folder not approved Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (Flux 2 Klein 9B) - The image model, Flux 2 Klein 9B from Black Forest Labs. It is a fast 4-step model that can make a picture from words AND change a picture you give it.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen 3 8B, reads the prompt) - Reads your prompt and turns the words into something the image model understands.
  • Load VAE (Flux 2) - Turns the finished render into a picture you can see, and a picture into the model's own format.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Images from Folder Pixaroma (1. your old pictures) - Point it at a folder of pictures made with ComfyUI and pick them. Its path output tells Prompt Reader where each picture is, and its resize is set to Max megapixels 1, so width and height give a canvas of about 1 megapixel in the shape of the old picture.
  • Text Join Two Pixaroma (2. words to add to every prompt) - Adds your own words to the end of EVERY prompt, with a comma between. Leave the second box empty to use the old prompts as they are, or type something like in winter, snow everywhere to change them all at once.
  • Seed Pixaroma (3. random or fixed) - The seed. F (fixed) gives the same result every Run, R (random) a new one each Run.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • Prompt Reader Pixaroma (reads the prompt saved in each picture) - Opens each picture and reads the prompt saved inside it. Wired to path, it reads the picture where it is. It reads PNG, JPG and WebP, from ComfyUI, Automatic1111, Forge and Civitai.
  • CLIP Text Encode (reads the prompt) - Reads the prompt through the text encoder.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (empty negative) - An empty negative prompt. Klein runs at CFG 1, where the negative does nothing, but the KSampler still needs one plugged in.
  • Empty Flux 2 Latent (blank canvas) - The blank canvas the picture is painted on, at the size it receives.
  • KSampler (4 steps) - The render: 4 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple, the settings Klein is made for.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (keeps each picture's name) - Saves each new picture as PNG into ComfyUI/output/Re-created, with the name of its old picture.
  • Image Compare Pixaroma (old and new, drag across it) - The old picture and the new one on top of each other. Drag across it to compare. It shows the last pair of the Run.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

WhatTime
6 old pictures, about 1 MP eachabout 16 s, under 3 s a picture
Each picture you addabout 2 s more

Klein needs 4 steps, so it is fast: about 1.7 s for a 1024 x 1024 picture from a prompt and about 3 s for an edit at 1 megapixel, where it also reads your picture.

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (about 18 GB for Klein and its text encoder), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

 On a 16 GB card

Timed on an RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB with 32 GB of RAM:

  • Klein took about 3 to 6 times as long, about 10 s even for one picture: Klein and its text encoder (17 GB together) do not fit in 16 GB, so parts of them load again on every Run, and a second Run is no faster.
